ETERNAL_WHINNY.title: Eternal Whinny
ETERNAL_WHINNY.description: Whenever an enemy dies, gain 2 Strength. When facing a lone enemy, apply 2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable.
ABUNDANCE.title: Abundance
ABUNDANCE.description: At the end of combat, heal HP equal to the stack count.
QUICK_SIGHT.title: Quick Sight
QUICK_SIGHT.description: When this steed merges with Calyrex, shuffle an Astral Barrage into your draw pile for each stack.
HEAVY_LANCE.title: Heavy Lance
HEAVY_LANCE.description: When this steed merges with Calyrex, shuffle a Glacial Lance into your draw pile for each stack, and grant Calyrex Ice Wall.
MOUNTED_GLASTRIER.title: Mounted: Glastrier
MOUNTED_SPECTRIER.title: Mounted: Spectrier
STEED_GUARD.title: Steed Guard
STEED_GUARD.description: This steed shields Calyrex: unblocked damage to Calyrex is redirected to this steed instead.
DYNAMAX_FORM_POWER.title: Dynamax Form
DYNAMAX_FORM_POWER.description: Your damage is tripled until the end of next turn.
TEMPORARY_THORNS_POWER.title: Temporary Thorns
TEMPORARY_THORNS_POWER.description: When attacked, deal {Amount} damage back. Fades at the end of your turn.
HELPING_HAND_POWER.title: Helping Hand
GRASSY_TERRAIN_POWER.title: Grassy Terrain
GRASSY_TERRAIN_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, Feed 3 to your steeds and gain 2 Abundance.
TRUCE_POWER.title: Truce
TRUCE_POWER.description: You cannot play Attack cards this turn.
FUTURE_SIGHT_POWER.title: Future Sight
ICE_WALL_POWER.title: Ice Wall
ICE_WALL_POWER.description: At the end of your turn, gain 8 [gold]Block[/gold]. Lost when you unmount.
FROZEN_POWER.title: Frozen
FROZEN_POWER.description: Damage taken is reduced by 35%. Stacks with Weak. Loses 1 stack at the end of each turn.
ACCELERATE_POWER.title: Accelerate
ACCELERATE_POWER.description: Every 2 Energy you spend, gain 1 Energy and 1 Strength.
SLOW_DOWN_POWER.title: Slow Down
SLOW_DOWN_POWER.description: Every 2 Energy you spend, add a free Exhaust copy of your last played card to hand.
CANNOT_MOUNT_POWER.title: Cannot Mount
CANNOT_MOUNT_POWER.description: You cannot mount a steed this combat.
LEECH_SEED_POWER.title: Leech Seed
LEECH_SEED_POWER.description: This enemy loses 8 HP at the end of each turn; its owner heals 4 HP.
PRESSURE_POWER.title: Pressure
INGRAIN_POWER.title: Ingrain
INGRAIN_POWER.description: Draw a card whenever you Feed or gain Abundance.
SOUL_HEART_POWER.title: Soul Heart
SOUL_HEART_POWER.description: Draw a card and gain 1 Energy whenever a unit dies.
TRICK_POWER.title: Trick
P_P_RESTORE_POWER.title: PP Restore
P_P_RESTORE_POWER.description: The first X-cost card played each turn restores energy.
FRIENDLY_GUARD_POWER.title: Friendly Guard
PLATED_ARMOR_POWER.title: Plated Armor
PLATED_ARMOR_POWER.description: At the end of your turn, gain {Amount} Block.
ENCORE_POWER.title: Encore
ENCORE_POWER.description: This enemy repeats its locked action at the end of each turn.
FLY_POWER.title: Fly
DEFIANT_POWER.title: Defiant
DEFIANT_POWER.description: Gain 1 Strength whenever a debuff is applied to you.
LAST_RESORT_POWER.title: Last Resort
LAST_RESORT_POWER.description: Energy does not reset each turn.
SPOTLIGHT_POWER.title: Spotlight
SPOTLIGHT_POWER.description: Attack damage taken is increased by 50%.
PSYCHIC_NOISE_POWER.title: Psychic Noise
MOUNT_MERGE_POWER.title: Merge
MOUNT_MERGE_POWER.description: This steed is merging with Calyrex.
PP_RESTORE_POWER.title: PP Restore
PP_RESTORE_POWER.description: The first X-cost card you play each turn restores energy.
ABILITY_CAPSULE_POWER.title: Ability Capsule
ABILITY_CAPSULE_POWER.description: Your first 2 Power cards cost 0 this turn.
